verdict.rationale: AWS ships Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a first-party managed platform for agents rather than a blog vision. Its product pages describe deploying agents built with any framework (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Strands) and any model to production, with built-in security, tracing of agent steps, and authentication and access control for tool, MCP and Lambda connections. Missing for 10: in-depth technical documentation beyond marketing product pages, explicit multi-agent orchestration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the runtime in production.
